objective: Produce a complete, reproducible artifact-bounded reconciliation of custom mechanisms declared in source, migrations, and enabled role configuration, and map each declaration to surviving runtime evidence.

scope.database: production read-only database using the identical read-only role
rules: Enumerate every CREATE TABLE statement in all migrations/*.up.sql through the final migration without truncation.
Enumerate source declarations and runtime emitters for custom mechanisms, including file, line, symbol, and mechanism name.
Retrieve exact SQL and output for organization_roles and role_model_bindings, including enabled, executable, and active status where present; report the actual schema if column names differ.
Run the complete DISTINCT aggregate_type and COUNT(*) query on outbox_events, including zero-count interpretation only as "0 rows observed".
Enumerate all embedding_invocations rows by relevant dimensions and map each writing call site to its declared mechanism.
Search the complete frozen worktree for exact-five|exactly five|five custom mechanisms and report the search scope and exact result.
Preserve separate provenance for source declarations, migration tables, enabled role configuration, emitters, and runtime rows; do not assume those sets are equivalent.

deliverable: Non-truncated machine-readable inventory with one row per declared mechanism, table, role binding, emitter, and runtime evidence source.
Explicit OBSERVED, DERIVED, and UNKNOWN labels with file:line or SQL provenance for every row.
Exact raw SQL outputs and query parameters sufficient for third-party reproduction.
A final mechanism count only if the enumeration is demonstrably complete and the counting rule is explicitly stated.
acceptance_test: A third party can rerun all cited source searches and read-only SQL against commit 4e0853d3 and the identical database role and obtain identical outputs; no migration or source inventory is truncated; every declaration and runtime mapping has explicit provenance or is labeled UNKNOWN; zero rows are not treated as proof of non-use; and no exact mechanism count is asserted unless the complete enumeration and counting rule are reproduced.
